# enhance/sketch

## Functions

### sketch()

```ts
function sketch(root?): () => void;
```

The opt-in pencil layer for server-rendered field-guide pages.

Markup contract, all plain attributes so any host can use it without React:

- `data-sketch-root` marks a positioned host; its overlay is drawn inside it.
- `data-sketch="circle" | "underline"` marks inline text to annotate.
- `data-sketch-leader-x` / `data-sketch-leader-y` (fractions of the target box)
  on a note draw a leader from the note to the `data-sketch-target` inside the
  same `data-sketch-item`. The layout decides whether leaders apply by setting
  `--caps-sketch-leader: on` on the note.

Strokes use `currentColor`, so a theme switch recolors them without a redraw.
The host receives `data-sketch-drawn` once annotations exist, which lets Caps
hide the static CSS fallbacks they replace.
